🇲🇽🌎 EDGAR MORIN, ARCHITECT OF "COMPLEX THOUGHT," DIES AT 104

Edgar Morin — Jewish son of Salonika refugees, French Resistance fighter, six-decade architect of "complex thought," lifelong critic of Israeli occupation — has died at 104. La Jornada notes he influenced "generations of researchers, teachers and students around the world" and kept publishing past 100. His entire project was the opposite of how Western academia operates: refuse to fragment knowledge into disciplinary boxes, refuse to separate science from politics from culture from history. One of the few European public intellectuals who consistently named Gaza a genocide.

🚨🇲🇽 CUAUTLA MAYOR CAPTURED — PAN POLITICIAN PAID BY SINALOA CARTEL TO FUND CAMPAIGN

PAN mayor Jesús Corona Damián of Cuautla, Morelos was captured in Acapulco's Costa Azul neighborhood after days as a fugitive — caught carrying a pistol — for taking Sinaloa Cartel money to fund his electoral campaign in exchange for protecting their operations across the state. Harfuch confirmed the arrest as part of Operativo Enjambre, which has now taken down 85+ officials and 7 sitting mayors. He was filmed meeting with "El Barbas" of the cartel. The PAN keeps insisting Morena is the "narco-party" — meanwhile their own alcaldes get cuffed one by one.

SEMAFOR: US vows to keep some Canada, Mexico tariffs as trade pact deadline looms
May 28, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Semafor relays USTR Greer's tariff position with zero quotes from any Mexican official. Frames "dimming hopes" of free-trade renewal — but only the US gets to have hopes.

🇲🇽 Buried as factoid, not lead: Mexico just posted a record monthly trade surplus, exports up nearly 33% YoY to $72B. Mexico is now Washington's largest trading partner. None of it is treated as Mexican leverage — it's presented as background while Greer dictates terms.

• "Significant trade issues with Canada" — Greer
• "Giant US trade deficit remained a cause of concern" — Greer
• Not a single Mexican official quoted in the entire piece.

BBC: How my brother went from liberal Hollywood actor to manosphere "messiah"
May 27, 2026 | 🟡

📰 BBC builds a year-long documentary around Mexican influencer El Temach — Latin America's biggest manosphere figure — through his sister Alex's distancing testimony. The frame is "shocking transformation," not "predictable algorithmic outcome."

🔍 What is missing: zero statistics on Mexico's femicide crisis, which is the actual context for why a Mexican manosphere influencer's misogyny matters. The piece reads algorithmic radicalization as a content-moderation puzzle, not a state-policy gap. $1.5M earnings estimate framed as profit motive over politics.

• "BBC and Miss Jacqui from the BBC, we don't need your permission to be men." — El Temach
• "He got this Messiah complex, like he's the one that has to fix [men's issues]." — Alex
• "I think he knows what he's doing on some level." — Alex

LATIN TIMES: Sheinbaum Warns of "Real Risk" of Foreign Intervention in Mexico Elections
May 29, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Latin Times runs Sheinbaum's case mostly straight — but the headline scare-quotes "Real Risk," signaling her claim is contested rather than documented.

🇲🇽 What is documented: Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit traced 96.7 million pesos from the US embassy via USAID to anti-corruption NGO MCCI between 2018 and early 2024. That's the receipt she pulled. The paper trail exists.

• "Yes, there can be a risk of foreign intervention in Mexico's elections, yes"
• "They were financed by institutions of the United States through the embassy"
• "In Mexico, Mexicans decide"

May 27 – May 29

1. LATIN TIMES — Sheinbaum Warns of "Real Risk" of Foreign Intervention (🟡) — lets her cite USAID/MCCI funding, but scare-quotes her warning in the headline
2. BBC — El Temach manosphere "messiah" profile (🟡) — year-long doc on Mexican misogynist influencer, zero femicide context
3. SEMAFOR — US vows to keep some Canada, Mexico tariffs (🟡) — zero Mexican officials quoted, frames permanent tariffs as US prerogative

🚨🇲🇽 <u>STEEL EXPORTS COLLAPSE 54% — TRUMP'S SECTION 232 50% TARIFF DOING ITS JOB</u>

Mexican steel exports to the US fell 54% in the first bimester of 2026 versus the same period last year, El Financiero columnist Enrique Quintana documents, following the 24% drop already booked in 2025. Trump's Sección 232 tariff — currently 50% — is now a structural feature of the bilateral relationship, not a temporary measure. Washington offers reductions to 25% only for companies that reshore investment to US soil. The pretext is "national security." The mechanism is industrial coercion. T-MEC's second negotiation round opens June 16 in Washington.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>IÑÁRRITU JOINS EL COLEGIO NACIONAL — FIRST FILMMAKER IN 80 YEARS</u>

"Mientras más lejos y afuera estamos, más mexicanos somos," Alejandro González Iñárritu told El Colegio Nacional this week, becoming the first filmmaker admitted to Mexico's most prestigious cultural institution in its 80-year history. His acceptance speech, La alucinación consensuada, grounded cinema in Mesoamerican visual language — light, framing, sound. "Sigamos siendo humanos, haciendo cine con humanos, para humanos." Mexico's diaspora producing world-defining art is not exile. It is projection.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>WHAT THE EU TRADE DEAL ACTUALLY COSTS — UAM ECONOMIST WARNS DIVERSIFICATION ≠ SOVEREIGNTY</u>

"Toda apertura comercial sin protección política es sinónimo de subordinación," writes UAM Iztapalapa economist Carolina Hernández Calvario in Contralínea, breaking down the May 22 Mexico-EU modernized trade deal: $94.5B bilateral trade in 2025, 35% growth projected over five years — and European firms now compete equally for Mexican public procurement, locking in foreign access to energy and critical minerals. Trading US dependency for European dependency is not sovereignty, she warns. Industrial policy is. Domestic suppliers are. State enterprises are.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM TAKES THE STAGE AT MONUMENTO A LA REVOLUCIÓN TODAY — 32-STATE ACCOUNTABILITY EVENT</u>

At 11 AM today, two years after her electoral landslide, Claudia Sheinbaum convenes Mexicans at the Monumento a la Revolución for a public accounting of her first 18 months — broadcast simultaneously across plazas in 31 states (Coahuila excluded for local elections). "En México, los mexicanos deciden — nadie más," she has framed the event, a direct response to the months-long foreign-interference push from Washington and the domestic opposition. "No robamos, no mentimos, y nunca los vamos a traicionar." The Zócalo is being held back for World Cup Fan Fest setup.
